title: How to market AI tool? HELP!
author: AgenticGameDev
selftext:
Hi all!  
I'm a system engineer by trade but have detoured a bit in to VR related work in Unity for last year (full time and part time before). In the process I love to set up solid systems and did see a clean lack in the feedback loops when working in unity and and later AI. So I created a test runner and later also extended it to AI. It's my bread and butter and working on a demo to be able to showcase the tool. But well summer and family duties blocks major progress. 

My questions to you:   
How would you recommend marketing such a tool? How not to marketing it? What kind of demos would be good? Make a game jam or sponsor a game jam. Youtube videos showcasing the workflows? Reaching out to studios instead of Indes?

The tool is here as references: [https://www.mooserunner.com/](https://www.mooserunner.com/) PLEASE don't see this as marketing. It's a honest questions!!!

I SUCK at marketing and branding and yes design. I know systems very well that is it.

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: Looking at your site, I don't understand what I'm paying for, am I paying for the tool, inference? Both?

replies.author: AgenticGameDev
replies.body: Thank you! I will clarify that. It’s a pure CLI tool no ai built in. Bring your own key for video though.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: I guess I don't know why I'd pay a subscription for that when it doesn't necessarily interact with your infrastructure.

replies.author: AgenticGameDev
replies.body: Fair point. I was thinking that charging in relation to the benefit would be more fair. Charging a big upfront cost feel unfair as you have not tested it out yet. But understand your point as well. Thank you! All feedback is gold!
